expectations.text: States the law has 5 chapters and 39 articles, not nine chapters
expectations.evidence: Claims 7 chapters ('organised in 7 chapters and roughly 39 articles'); corrects nine but states the wrong count

expectations.text: Places the personal data protection core in Chapter II (Articles 9-32)
expectations.evidence: Seven-chapter layout given; no article ranges and Chapter II not placed at Articles 9-32

expectations.text: Correctly names at least two sector-specific articles among Arts. 25-32 (for example recruitment/employees Art. 25, finance/banking Art. 27, big data/AI/cloud Art. 30)
expectations.evidence: Mentions sector topics (finance, employment, AI, cloud) but cites no article numbers in 25-32

expectations.text: States Article 38 is entry into force (January 1, 2026) and includes the SME/startup five-year opt-out
expectations.evidence: Gives the 1 Jan 2026 effective date generally but never ties it to Article 38 and omits the SME five-year opt-out

expectations.text: States Article 39 carries the transitional provisions (Decree 13-era consents and dossiers remain valid)
expectations.evidence: No mention of Article 39 or of Decree 13-era consents/dossiers remaining valid
